name: Arrow
description: An arrow that draws itself from one point of its clip box to another, straight or bent, its head riding the tip, with an optional label at the tail or the head (kept inside the box). Points are fractions of the box, so the same props work at any box size.

from.description: tail [x, y] as fractions of the box (0,0 top-left; 1,1 bottom-right)

to.description: tip [x, y] as fractions of the box

curve.description: bend: 0 straight; positive bows to the right of the direction of travel (clockwise), negative to the left

width.description: stroke width in px; default: 2.2% of the box's short side (at least 6)

at.description: Time it starts drawing: "line:9+0.3" or seconds from the clip start. Default: the clip start

label.description: short text at the tail or the head, at least 28 px (a long one takes two lines)

label_pos.description: start: behind the tail; end: past the head

label_at.description: Time the label appears: "line:9+0.8" or seconds from the clip start. Default: with the arrow

label_style.description: pill: white text on the arrow colour; plain: text in the ground's ink

ground.description: what it sits on; sets a plain label's colour
